entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Finally! I need to return these awful cycling shoes I bought. This is completely unacceptable.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

They're defective! They gave me terrible blisters on my heels after just one ride. The fit is all wrong, and I think the plate where the cleats attach is misaligned. I want a full refund, and I want it now.
Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and I understand your frustration. Let me just pull up your order information to check on the return eligibility.

You better check it and you better approve it. I've had them for about two and a half months. If I hear one word about 'policy' or 'time limits,' I'm going straight to your manager and then I'm writing a review on every website I can find.

I understand your position completely. One moment... Okay, I have your order here. I can see you purchased the cycling shoes 74 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window.
Wait, really? So you're just going to process it?

Yes, absolutely. I can process a full refund for you right away. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just pack the shoes in a box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
Oh. Wow. Okay, a full refund, you said? Not store credit?

That's correct, a full refund to your original method of payment. You should see it reflect in your account within 3-5 business days after our warehouse receives the return. The email with the label has just been sent.
Well, that was... much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you, Diana. I appreciate that.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
